headSection.title: Allow us to help you submit quantitative bids with precise rebar estimates that make you stand out in the crowd.
description: While our detailing estimates cover all data points required by a sales estimator, it also helps to forecast the rebar requirements for the fabrication shop. Estimating the accurate usage of rebar helps in eliminating waste and identifying the crucial accessories required during the fabrication process. We understand how important it is to produce an error-free bar bending schedule that fits into the concrete framework, avoiding rework and cost overruns.

Using the latest 3D modeling tools and in compliance with the AISC, ASTM, CRSI, ACI, RSIC, IS, and BS building codes, our rebar detailers generate precise estimates and drawings that help you visualize your projects.

estimate.head: Get Rebar Detailing Estimates FREE. Yes, you heard us right!
estimate.body: We will assess your projects absolutely free of cost and point out schedules that work best for your project's quick turnaround in no time at all!
